measure.how: per scene in a fresh process (tools/u8_perturb.py _one): MujocoScene, the goal capture, then per mode the copied perturb.build(mode, seed=20260918).begin at the smoke start's episode seed, the edited world compiled (scene.sync), drawn fresh at the goal pose, the depth gate at the goal and the start pose (ray caster on the compiled model, stride 4), end, the unedited world compiled again and redrawn at the goal; RSS from /proc/self/status
measure.light_rule: light: the dome and the sun scaled by s with colour temperature T change every pixel's linear radiance by f_c = s * blackbody_c(T) (UsdLux.BlackbodyTemperatureAsRgb, luminance 1); applied inside the scene's tone curve, y = 255 srgb(w/(1+w)), w = f_c (floor + e^k x^gamma) (raw look: y = clip(f_c x)); MuJoCo's own light terms clamp at 1, so the model's lights are not edited; depth untouched
measure.look_rule: the scene's look (fill share, light gain, shadow map and its fitted square, tone curve) is fitted once on the unperturbed goal and stays fixed under every perturbation: an edited world is drawn through the same renderer response, as in Isaac; the goal picture is the unperturbed one, captured before the first begin and served from the cache at the goal pose (vs-sim's rule)
